statement: The payment record indicates that employee J. Okafor's account is active with a monthly salary of USD 6,200, but the bank account holder was changed this week to a different name, K. Lindqvist.
judge_text:
NEITHER

It merely restates the record ("the bank account holder was changed this week to a different name") without asserting any value is wrong, recommending verification, or addressing whether to release the pay.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
